{{Quote|Spies? I'm no intelligence operative. I'm a pilot!|Rus Kal Kin objects to learning he's been chosen to find a mole in the alliance|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 2">[[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]]</ref>}}
'''Rus Kal Kin''' was a [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]]. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] refugee relief transports on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], for which he became famous on the planet. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] reformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] he became a pilot for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Whilst flying for the Rebels he performed with enough skill and was deemed trustworthy enough to be selected by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to be part of a [[Stealth Squadron|team]] to uncover a mole within the Alliance. The team worked entirely off the books, with only [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] knowing of their existence outside of the team's members. As well as discovering the mole they were also tasked with finding a suitable planet on which the Alliance could set up a new base.

==Behind the scenes==
Ru Kal Kin first appeared the in [[Star Wars (2013) 2|second issue]] of the comic book series titled simply [[Star Wars (2013)|Star Wars]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The issue was written by [[Brian Wood]], illustrated by [[Carlos D'Anda]] and colored by [[Gabe Eltaeb]]. It was released on [[February]] [[February 13|13]] [[2013]].
